listen:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create production-quality Apple Watch UI concept board for Nodpilot, adapting the attached Nodpilot phone design visual language to a real watch-sized experience. Attached image is BRAND REFERENCE ONLY, not edit target: use its black/cyan palette, simple system typography, restrained surfaces. Do not reproduce phone layout, avatar, gear, More or account screens on watch.
One coherent SIX-STATE board, landscape 1536x1024 pixels, 3 columns x 2 rows. Six identical front-facing dark Apple Watch rounded-square cases with small right crown, no straps or hands. Watch content viewport approximately 198x242 logical points; no squashed phone layouts. Each watch is large and readable with realistic watch safe margins. Small caption outside beneath each device. Tiny board heading 'Nodpilot / Watch — Listen'. Background dark charcoal #111315. Screen pure near-black #050607, cyan #00C4E8, white #F5F7F8, secondary grey #A4ABB1, muted panels #111518, red for recording/end, amber only for paused. Calm readable UI, real SF Pro-like font, minimal icons, native pill buttons. System clock '9:41' small upper right in each screen. No heavy shadows or gradients, no excess waveform ornament.

TOP LEFT caption '01 · Ready'. On watch: small centered outlined cyan capsule 'Meeting' below clock. Center cyan waveform icon inside a large cyan rounded Start button with dark text 'Start'. Below small phone connection icon and secondary 'iPhone connected'. Preserve existing mode capsule + Start pattern. No mode selector chevron, mode follows phone.

TOP MIDDLE caption '02 · Recording'. On watch: mode capsule Meeting; small red dot plus 'Recording'; large white monospaced timer '12:34'; one wide dark secondary 'Pause' button with pause symbol. Tiny two-dot horizontal pagination bottom, left dot active; subtle right edge navigation cue. No End next to Pause on this primary page, End lives on next control page.

TOP RIGHT caption '03 · Paused'. Same structure: Meeting capsule, amber 'Paused', large timer '12:34' white, cyan 'Resume' button. Two dots first active. No red recording dot.

BOTTOM LEFT caption '04 · Session controls'. Mode capsule Meeting; small Recording red dot; timer '12:34' secondary size; centered red-tinted dark pill button white/red icon and text 'End recording'. Smaller grey helper 'Keeps this session'. Two page dots, second active. End ends capture, never discards contents. This is horizontally adjacent controls page, not destructive confirmation.

BOTTOM MIDDLE caption '05 · Ended'. Compact heading 'Ended · 12:34'. Two stacked comfortable buttons: primary cyan 'Save'; secondary dark 'Continue recording' allowed two lines if necessary with deliberate matching center alignment. Small helper 'Same session'. No auto save, no 'New session', no discard. Both actions fit in viewport; Continue records same conversation after End.

BOTTOM RIGHT caption '06 · Saved'. Cyan outlined checkmark circle, clear heading 'Saved to History', subtitle 'View on iPhone'. Secondary dark button 'Continue recording'. Caption status means server-confirmed save, not merely dispatched to phone. Legible text, button within safe area.

This board is the first part of a unified proposed Watch workflow, not assertions of shipping behavior. Exact six screens, distinct states, real wearable proportions. Show only English copy quoted above. Do not add unsupported watch account settings, transcript tabs, people counts, language pickers, widgets or payment info. Ended/Resume distinction must be precise.
listenCorrection: Edit attached six-state Nodpilot Watch design board. Keep every watch, all typography, all colors, all contents, device placement and outside captions unchanged. Only fix pagination indicators: remove vertical three-dot indicators from the right edge of Recording and Session controls watches completely (these must not resemble More menus). Keep exactly two HORIZONTAL bottom page dots on Recording, Paused, and Session controls; active dot CYAN, inactive GREY consistently (Session controls second dot cyan, never red). Remove bottom page dots entirely from Ended and Saved watches because these are single-screen states. Ready has no dots. Do not change anything else. This is precise UI cleanup, not a new design.
reading:
Create PART TWO of the attached Nodpilot Watch UI board, EXACT SAME device frames, 3 columns x 2 rows, 1536x1024 landscape, identical black cyan minimal system-font UI, same scale and margins, six large front-facing Apple Watches without straps. Attached board is reference for visual continuity. Approximately 198x242 logical points per watch viewport. Small 9:41 clock top right each. Small outside captions. Only six states specified below. No phone layout or account settings.
TOP LEFT caption '07 · Translate'. Small cyan 'EN → ZH' language direction. Small grey English source: 'The meeting starts at three.' Below significantly larger white translated Chinese exactly '会议三点开始。' arranged in two naturally spaced lines if needed, clear Chinese system sans font. Bottom small red dot 'Listening', two horizontal page dots with first cyan active and second grey inactive (swipe to recording controls). Tiny subtle scroll indicator only if needed; no More icon, no permanent action button stealing reading area.
TOP MIDDLE caption '08 · Live Q&A'. Cyan outlined mode capsule 'Live Q&A'. Small grey question 'What should I say next?' and larger white answer 'Ask which task needs attention first.' on 3-4 readable left-aligned lines. Bottom small red dot 'Listening' plus two horizontal page dots first cyan. Reading answer must still visibly show listening ongoing.
TOP RIGHT caption '09 · Saving'. Cyan outlined cloud upload icon, heading 'Saving…', subdued text 'Waiting for confirmation'. No successful checkmark, no continue/new session button, no recording indicator, no pagination. One subtle progress spinner. Calm waiting state.
BOTTOM LEFT caption '10 · Save failed'. Small amber warning icon, white heading 'Couldn’t save', secondary 'Try again on iPhone or retry here.' Primary cyan button 'Retry save'. Fit text and button comfortably. No checkmarks, no destructive dismiss, no claims that local content has been permanently saved. No dots.
BOTTOM MIDDLE caption '11 · Connection lost'. Phone outline with small disconnected mark in amber. Heading 'iPhone disconnected'. Supporting text 'Recording status unavailable'. Secondary cyan-accent dark button 'Reconnect'. Do not show recording clock advancing or red REC, because actual recording status is unknown. No misleading offline capability claims. No dots. Button sufficiently large.
BOTTOM RIGHT caption '12 · Always-On'. Same watch frame, dimmer static display, small subdued 'Meeting', white-grey timer '12:34', dim red dot and subdued 'Recording'. No translation or transcript on this privacy-minded proposed always-on state. No buttons, no bright cyan panels, no animation, no pagination. Clearly lower luminance, still legible.
Style consistency: #050607 background, #111518 panels, #00C4E8 cyan, #F5F7F8 text, #A4ABB1 secondary. System typography, readable real-watch density, no gradients, no decorative waveforms. This is a design concept proposing these states, not proof of existing connectivity or save behavior. Leave intentional whitespace, don't overcrowd any watch.
v2ReadyEdit: Precise edit to the first of the TWO attached Nodpilot Watch boards: edit ONLY the Listen board containing six screens labeled 01 Ready, 02 Recording, 03 Paused, 04 Session controls, 05 Ended, 06 Saved. The second board (07–12 Translate / feedback) is NOT the edit target. Output ONLY revised 01–06 Listen board at the same 1536x1024 landscape resolution. Remove the small cyan phone outline icon AND the grey 'iPhone connected' text from the lower portion of the TOP LEFT Ready watch. Leave that area empty black. Keep the Meeting capsule and the large cyan Start button at their existing positions and sizes. Do not replace the removed line with Ready, a green dot, connection symbol, subtitle, helper, logo or any other text. Preserve every other pixel/layout as faithfully as possible: all five other screens, watch frames, titles, fonts, colors, timers, controls, pagination, captions, spacing. Keep exactly two bottom horizontal page dots on Recording, Paused and Session controls; none on Ready, Ended or Saved. This is only removal of normal connectivity status from Ready, not a redesign.

v3.scope: Retain v2 final image boards; integrate agent motion and complete UX specification
v3.motion: Browser-based deterministic animation and simulated state transitions; not generated video
